title: Date Butter - Okonomi Kitchen
ldKeywords: date butter, homemade date spread, easy date butter, 2-ingredient spread, healthy sweet spread, natural caramel spread, butter and date recipe, no-cook spread
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 stick (113 g) salted butter, room temperature
pink himalayan salt or flaky salt, to taste
ldInstructionsRaw: Add butter to a food processor and blend until smooth.
Add the dates and blend until smooth and well combined.
Taste and add more salt to your liking.
Transfer to air tight container. Keep refrigerated for up to 1 month.
